request.subject: UNIT:CANDY:JUGGERNAUT

layers.text: Recolour only the crystals and change nothing else: every pink crystal chunk of the golem becomes rock candy of glossy mint green, colour #7fe0b0, with lighter #c8f5df facets and white highlights, shaded deeper green #3fa878; a few chunks on the shoulders and fists are clear white sugar crystal. No pink is left. Keep the caramel brown bands and face, the tiny sprinkles, every shape, the pose, thick black outline and art style exactly the same, on a transparent background.
